title: Generic List<T> component
summary: Type a reusable component with a generic parameter and render props.
prompt: Finish the generic `List<T>`. It renders `items` in a `<ul>`. Each `<li>` uses `getKey(item)` as its key and `renderItem(item)` as its content. With no items, it renders `empty` (default "Nothing here") instead of the list.
hints: Declare it as `export function List<T>({ … }: ListProps<T>)`. TypeScript infers `T` from `items`.
Use `ReactNode` as the type for `renderItem`'s return value and for `empty`.
